title: 图志
prompt:
Render one complete, exceptional high-fidelity desktop GIS application UI for GAIA, edge-to-edge wide 16:10, ideally 1920×1200. No device or marketing mockup. The user works on “滨江公共空间研究”: stations, parks, 800 m straight-line buffers, validation and map export. Display a small “设计预览 · 示意数据” note. Chinese interface text is crisp and readable. Use the reference ONLY as the small unchanged orbital-G app icon beside GAIA. A substantial independent RIGHT COLUMN titled “GAIA 助手” must show conversation, tool evidence, an artifact and a comfortable bottom composer “描述分析或制图要求…”. Include theme/color access. Professional real working screen, no KPI cards, vendor ribbon or oversized welcome hero.
Direction C: 图志 / Map Folio. PUBLISHING-FIRST, a large beautifully authored white A4 landscape MAP PAGE dominates a cool pale gray-lilac pasteboard, thin millimetre rulers and quiet page shadow. “出图布局” tab active beside “地图”. On the page, professionally composed river-city cartography: blue-gray river, fine streets, teal parks, warm analysis zones, title “滨江公共空间”, subtitle “站点周边 800 米公园分布”; a right-side whitespace column holds an elegant legend, tiny locator map, meaningful scale and north arrow. Source note “示意数据 · 仅用于设计预览”. North arrow selected with subtle blue resize handles proves hand editing. LEFT sidebar has two document thumbnails “分析地图 / 地图版式” and semantic element outline “地图框 / 标题 / 图例 / 指北针 / 比例尺”, rather than A's layer stack. RIGHT independent assistant shows request “把图例放到右侧，检查标注遮挡”, a concise answer, “核验版面” button, “预览 PDF” artifact and comfortable composer. Narrow header offers “添加元素 / 对齐 / 撤销” and solid cobalt “导出”, never a ribbon. Precise humanist sans application typography; expressive typography only in the authored map title. Rounded native controls, graphite ink and restrained cobalt actions. Signature is gorgeous editable cartographic output with a designer's desk workflow.
notes: Generated map, quantities and task results are illustrative, not executed GIS analysis.
Use the supplied unchanged icon asset in any later implementation.
Selection and application implementation await the user's response.
approval_text: A 做主工作区，C 做出图模式。B 的流程抽屉融入 A。
